title: Receive goods
description: The storekeeper records goods received at a place; a tenant administrator posts it from My Tasks; the balance rises.
preconditions: the stock module is installed in the company

tasks.result: a draft receipt with a document id
the document is posted and one ledger entry is written

refusals: a role without StockPost is refused with 403
a second completion of the same post task writes nothing

title: Security: another company's card is not reachable
description: Negative process (D-170). A token of company A against the ids of company B answers one uniform 404, and nothing is written.
preconditions: two companies with the module installed

tasks.result: 404 for a document of another company

refusals: a token of another company: 404, the same answer as an unknown id
